natural_body: 40% discount lifts acquisition and revenue but cuts 30-day retention 12%; use selectively.

first.rationale: I intend to test onboarding simplification because onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and the inherited evidence links shorter onboarding to improved time-to-value and adoption. I would verify the onboarding result and the related activation-messaging result before committing, while avoiding promotional pricing because its retention damage threatens sustainable long-term revenue.
